line.t: Seven withdrawals, Mummy. Every one signed by Uncle Femi.
You're not surprised. Mummy, you knew?

vo.t: Fifteen years ago, I was dying. Femi paid my hospital bills.

line.t: When he took the money, I told myself I owed him.
So the fifteen million was to cover his hole?
If the in-laws paid, nobody would ask questions. God forgive me.
I protected my brother and broke my son.
Then fix it with me, Mummy. Tomorrow we go to the Okafors.

edit.sfx: music cut + deep boom on the line
